description: Implementation of QuicBatchWriterBuffer class managing buffer writes, including methods for pushing, popping, and debugging buffer states within the quic namespace.

classes.name: QuicBatchWriterBuffer
classes.description: A buffer management class for batching writes in QUIC protocol implementation.

methods.name: DebugString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the buffer state for debugging.

methods.name: Invariants
methods.description: Checks internal consistency of buffer and buffered writes.

methods.name: GetNextWriteLocation
methods.description: Returns pointer to next writable location in buffer.

methods.name: PushBufferedWrite
methods.description: Adds a new buffered write, copying data if necessary.

methods.name: PopBufferedWrite
methods.description: Removes a specified number of buffered writes and adjusts buffer.

methods.name: SizeInUse
methods.description: Returns the total size of data currently in buffer.
